Basic ATC

कॉपी करने के लिए तैयार

A phrase used by pilots to indicate they are prepared to receive and write down instructions or clearances.

Definition

A phrase used by pilots to indicate they are prepared to receive and write down instructions or clearances.

Operational example

Pilot advises: 'Ready to copy clearance to destination, go ahead.'

Localized term
